import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    w = 0.376
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*x**2 + p[3]*x*v + p[9]*x
            + c*(p[4] + p[5]*np.exp(-x) + p[6]*x**3)
            + s*(p[7]*x + p[8]*x**3))
